title: Sara's PDF report claims 'no personal statement' and recommends requesting one, but the demo fixture carries a personal statement that renders on-screen
evidence: pdf_report_data.gleam:822 insight: "...two documents on file, no bank statements, no personal statement. None of this is a red flag on its own..."; :899 rationale "...bank statements and a personal statement would strengthen the file."; :910 ev("Application on file", "No personal statement provided", "medium"); :952 rec("Request a personal statement", ...). Against client/src/demo/demo_fixtures.gleam:89 app_sara_json: \"personal_statement\":\"Junior developer at Kite Software, one year in, renting in Clontarf for two years.\" — rendered on-screen via client/src/pages/application_detail.gleam:185 `application_detail_personal_statement.view(app.personal_statement)`. The module's own header (lines 6-9) states: "All facts stay consistent with the client fixture stories (demo_fixtures.gleam / demo_store.gleam)".
detail: Screen↔PDF contradiction a demo user can hit: the on-screen application shows Sara's personal statement; the downloaded report says none was provided and recommends requesting one. Violates the module's stated fixture-consistency contract.
recommended_fix: Rewrite sara_parts() completeness note/insight/recs: drop the 'no personal statement' claims and the 'Request a personal statement' rec; substitute a real gap (e.g. character reference) and re-bake report-a-sara.pdf.

title: Liam's PDF report calls the landlord reference 'the only other attachment', contradicting the fixtures (1 document) and the note's own '1 of 5 categories' evidence
evidence: pdf_report_data.gleam:1356: "One document on file — payslips — with the landlord reference as the only other attachment. The form is the thinnest in the demo universe on corroboration." and :1283 insight: "But only one document beyond the landlord reference — payslips — is on file...". Fixtures give Liam exactly one document: client/src/demo/demo_store.gleam:448 `"a-liam" -> [doc("doc-liam-1", app_id, "payslips.pdf", ProofOfIncome)]` (mirrored in pdf_prebake documents_for a-liam: only base_doc("doc-liam-1", "proof_of_income", "payslips.pdf")). The same note's evidence item says "Documents provided" / "1 of 5 categories".
detail: The landlord reference is a reference contact (Karen Whitmore), not a document/attachment — the on-screen leaderboard shows no landlord-ref doc chip for Liam. Prose implies 2 attachments while the fixtures and the note's own evidence say 1.
recommended_fix: Rephrase liam_parts() completeness note and insight to 'one document on file — payslips — with the landlord reference as the only other reference on file' (or equivalent) so no second attachment is implied.

title: pub visibility widened on two functions with no external callers (payloads, competition_ranks)
evidence: server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:325 `pub fn payloads() -> List(ReportPayload) {` — only caller is inside the same module at :743 `list.map(payloads(), fn(p) {`; the new server test imports pdf_prebake only for `documents_for`. client/src/demo/demo_store.gleam:1080 `pub fn competition_ranks(` — repo-wide grep shows callers only at demo_store.gleam:999; the new client test uses `demo_store.leaderboard` and `leaderboard_helpers.top_three_ids`, never `competition_ranks`.
detail: Needless public API surface on demo-only modules. Harmless functionally, but pub-with-no-external-caller misleads future readers about intended reuse.
recommended_fix: Drop `pub` from pdf_prebake.payloads and demo_store.competition_ranks (keep `pub` on documents_for — the pin test uses it), or add a comment stating the export is deliberate.
